description.en: Generic small simple terrestrial impact-crater process/form artistic concept informed by NASA/USGS Barringer aerial image, not exact Meteor Crater DEM, measured real dimensions, locality, age or geological confirmation from shape alone. Nominal2400x2200x420m educational terrain module includes plain with bowl substantially below surrounding level and raised rim. Original irregular outline and radial erosion simplified; no shock metamorphism or impact-origin proof represented. No central peak because frozen scope simple crater. Colors and erosion exaggerated only within illustrative readability, not measured stratigraphy.
